notes: DECISION: bare A (dark #131314 in light mode, mint #69FFAD in dark mode) or the n8n mint tile with the dark A kept as one file. The brand's app icon is the mint A on a dark teal (#0A363A) tile, but no SVG of that tile exists (webclip/favicons are PNG, abyssale.com/brand|press|media-kit are 404, the app's favicons are PNG). The company's own SVGs of the A are the n8n icons (black tile + lavender A, mint tile + #131314 A) and the app loader. I shipped the bare A: #131314 in light mode (matches the black Abyssale wordmark), mint #69FFAD in dark mode (matches the app icon's A). Reviewer may prefer the n8n mint tile with dark A kept as-is (downloads/abyssale/src10/abyssale-dark.svg) as one file for both themes.
